judgment.rationale:
The only available evidence collector — getModelCard — returned null, indicating that no model card exists for "churn-predictor-v1" / "churn-predictor-endpoint". 

RA-3.v4 requires a substantive risk assessment that covers: (a) identification of threats and vulnerabilities, likelihood and magnitude of harm from unauthorized access/use/disclosure/disruption/modification/destruction, and adverse effects on individuals from PII processing; (b) integration of risk assessment results with organizational risk management; (c) documentation of results in a security/privacy plan, risk assessment report, or equivalent artifact; (d) periodic review of results; (e) dissemination to defined personnel/roles; and (f) updates upon significant changes or at defined frequency.

A model card is the primary artifact in this environment where risk assessment documentation, intended use, limitations, risk ratings, and evaluation details would be recorded. Its complete absence means there is no evidence of any risk assessment having been conducted, documented, reviewed, disseminated, or maintained for this model. None of the six sub-requirements of RA-3.v4 can be confirmed as satisfied.
